profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Spectra Defense Technologies | B.S Software Engineering - Iowa State University

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Las Cruces, New Mexico, United States · On-site

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a multithreaded embedded Ethernet application for receiving and processing UDP MPEG transport streams, including a Telemetry Attributes Transfer Standard (TMATS) parser for configuring H.264 I/O, HDSDI inputs, Ethernet IP addresses, and command/response interfaces, with socket-based networking to packetize data using the IRIG Ch 10 standard, store it to disk, and stream it to configurable IP endpoints.
Packaged device drivers, libraries, and custom scripts using PetaLinux and Nios II, and debugged embedded targets using AMD Embedded Design Tools and ModelSim.
Partnered directly with customers on-site to integrate and bring up systems, troubleshoot software and configuration issues, and provide training on internal tools.
Built and enforced GitHub CI/CD pipelines to automate software builds, testing, and development workflows.
Worked across engineering disciplines to identify, prioritize, and resolve technical challenges, balancing customer requirements, product constraints, and development priorities.

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Refactored Enzyme code to React Testing Library to ensure the application follows current standards.
Modified dependencies for the application's installer. The installer notifies the end-user when a dependency is not installed and provides links for download.
Created a WPF applet for users to submit any issues they experienced with the main application. This applet gathered the current logs from the main application and the machine's specifications.

positions.title: Engineering Technician
positions.description: Supported new product development through flow, cycle, and vibration testing and authored detailed test reports.
